## Description
Briefly describe the change, its motivation, and the physics or architecture rationale.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] Physics engine or math enhancement
- [ ] UI / Design refinement
- [ ] Mobile app feature (React Native / Expo)
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Documentation update

## Verification & Testing
- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes with strict mode
- [ ] `npm test` passes all unit, integration, and E2E scenarios
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds cleanly

## Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have added appropriate unit or integration tests
- [ ] I have updated documentation where necessary
